name: merchant-identity-service
description: The separate, other-team-owned system of record for who a merchant is, whether they may trade, their payout account, and their credit limit. This project reads trading status and payout account from it to gate settlement and route payouts; it never writes to it. Not published as an org-service in this environment yet, so its contract is not yet resolvable — no interface has been provided.

provenance.sourceUrl: assumed — no published document exists; modeled on common merchant KYC/eligibility API shapes for internal payment platforms
